title: Majaa
desc: Aadhi and Mathi, along with their father, go to a village and help a retired officer pay off his debts to a landlord. Soon, Mathi forcibly marries the landlord's daughter to teach him a lesson.

title: Naam
desc: A dreaded terrorist's attempt at fleeing the country forever is foiled by the police and his brother is killed in the shootout. He then employs four out-of-work youths to hijack a plane.

title: Thiraipada Nagaram
desc: Youngsters in Chennai seek film industry opportunities, renting a supportive house and receiving recommendations from a film production manager, but face disagreements.

title: Vanmam
desc: Friends Radha and Chelladurai lead a carefree life. When Radha accidentally kills Chelladurai's brother-in-law, it turns them bitter foes, and a cunning man uses their enmity to his benefits

title: 12 B
desc: While working at a friend's garage, Shakti falls in love with Jotika. However, her parents want her to marry Pratap, a rich businessman. What will be the outcome of this love triangle

title: Vaanatha Pola
desc: Vellaichaamy sacrifices love for his three brothers, resisting marriage when he discovers his beloved intends to separate them.

title: Acharam
desc: Suriya, a sub-inspector, hates modern women and kills them secretly at night. When he meets Ramya, the wife of an architect, he becomes obsessed with her.

title: Ettu Thikkum Madha Yana
desc: When his father is found dead, Natesan decides to find the culprits. While investigating, he learns that his father's death is connected to the murder of his childhood friend.

title: Jathi Malli
desc: After her mother's murder, singer Sriranjani moves to Ooty and meets Kesavan, another dejected soul. Along come two run-away lovers, who bring a fresh perspective to the lives of these two.

title: Minnale
desc: A man falls in love with a woman and cons his way into her heart through lies. When she finds out and confronts him, he has no sign of remorse as he feels that everything is fair in love and war.

title: Aaranyam
desc: Aravind, a young robber, falls in love with Divya who is one of his victims. But her father, a police officer, is against their relationship, so they both elope into a dense forest and live together.

title: Pandiya Naadu
desc: Shiva's perfect life turns upside down after his brother is killed by a dreaded gangster. Bent on revenge, Shiva turns into a ruthless killer and vows to eliminate his brother's killers.

title: Anjala
desc: The members of a family join hands to save their ancestral tea shop from being demolished, even after receiving various threats from the government.

title: Amma Appa Cheliam
desc: Chellam, a boy from a poor family, is in love with a rich girl but ignores her by focusing on his career while making his parents proud by scoring the highest in the district.

title: Iniyavaley
desc: Prabhakar is firm on marrying only after he clears his exams and becomes a collector. When his parents fix his marriage, his protests lead to complications and he ends up marrying the bride's sister.

title: Cheran Chozhan Pandian
desc: After being released from jail Cheran, Chozhan, and Pandian are determined to reform, they encounter the corrupt politician Swamy. They befriend Gayathri, Swamy's sister, leading to complications.

title: Pattayya Kelappannum Pandi Yaa
desc: Velpandiyan, a minibus driver, falls in love with Kanmani, a regular commuter of the bus. However, they face several challenges as their relationship grows further.
